projects.title: Decentralized Social Media Application
projects.bodyText:
- Built a decentralized app on Ethereum with Solidity to verify provenance and combat misinformation.
 - Modeled an on-chain dynamic reputation system, handling 1000+ simulated users and transactions.
 - Engineered a consensus mechanism using a voting threshold-based governance model.
 - Integrated IPFS based decentralized storage, ensuring 100% immutability and tamper resistance.

projects.title: Streakio
projects.bodyText:
- Developed a native, habit tracking Android application with real-time streak synchronization.
 - Implemented Firebase Authentication & Firestore, enabling secure logins with 100% uptime during testing.
 - Designed an intuitive and modern Material 3 user interface with Jetpack Compose, employing MVVM architecture and Kotlin Coroutines/Flow for efficient asynchronous operations and state management.

projects.title: GPT ChatBot
projects.bodyText:
- Built a ChatGPT-powered chatbot, handling 2,000+ queries per day in a simulated test environment.
 - Leveraged OpenAI’s API to create a conversational AI capable of engaging in natural language interactions.
 - Developed backend functionalities including user session management, conversation history storage, and secure REST endpoints for API request handling, reducing response latency to <200ms under load tests.

projects.title: Portfolio Webpage
projects.bodyText:
- Designed and deployed a responsive personal portfolio site with >90% Lighthouse performance score.
 - Implemented interactive design principles to ensure optimal viewing experience across various devices.
 - Utilized Git and GitHub for version control, maintaining 100% deployment uptime via CI/CD pipelines.
 - Enhanced UI/UX by incorporating intuitive navigation, smooth elements, and a clean, minimalist design.

projects.title: Connect 4
projects.bodyText:
- Developed a fully functional Connect 4 game, incorporating core logic in adherence to game rules.
 - Designed a robust AI opponent using minimax algorithm with stochastic elements and alpha-beta pruning.
 - Applied modular OOP design and coding practices, facilitating easy updates and feature expansions.
